statusHistory.note: Near's first editorial column. Operator-commissioned directly in chat ('can the chief editor publish our first editorial column'), so trust: auto per rules.md's trust-gate (operator naming/commissioning something directly is the approval step). Held at status: draft, not active, purely because heroImage is still null pending near-illustrator generation tooling -- see content/photo-requests.md's zombie-listicle-problem entry. English copy, sourcing (thespiritsbusiness.com on Club Soda's Jan 2026 closure, happycow.net on Redemption Bar Shoreditch's closure), and internal linking (Lucky Saint, Ocean Beach Cafe, Ishigaki Jujitsu -- all verified currently open) are otherwise complete and link-density-compliant. Scoped by near-editor with near-seo (differentiation angle: Near verifies currency, most listicles don't) and RADAR-X (real cross-market pattern surfaced this session: Club Soda, The New Bar, Better Sunday, and Redemption Bar all turned out closed while researching sober-curious content in London and SF). Structural home is a collection per schema.ts's own definition of a collection as 'an editorial story' -- collectionMetaSchema requires placeSlugs.min(1), so a column with zero place references isn't structurally supported without a new content type; this column genuinely references three real places, so no new type was needed. Flip to active + dispatch near-translator once the hero image lands.

Operator ran the queued photo-requests.md prompt through Gemini and dropped the result in content/photo-inbox/ -- strong match for the brief (boarded storefront, closed sign, unlit neon, glowing outdated review card on a phone). Wired into coverImage, disclosed as AI-generated per rules.md. All six locales were already written, so full-locale-coverage is satisfied -- flipping straight to active. Also added to content/editorial-column-index.json's slugs array and content/editorial-column.md's Series Index, which makes the header nav's COLUMN link live for the first time.

Rewritten to the LinkedIn-shareable/professional-audience register per BACKLOG.md's open thread #0a and content/editorial-column.md's 2026-09-01 update (reverses the earlier 'leave it as historical record' call). Facts, sourcing (thespiritsbusiness.com, happycow.net), and NearLink targets (lucky-saint-fitzrovia-london, ocean-beach-cafe-san-francisco, ishigaki-jujitsu-london) carried over unchanged -- this was a register/framing rewrite, not a re-reporting. All five other locales re-translated from the new English source via near-translator (one persona per locale), each validated against schema.ts's dek/seoDescription limits.

Given a public byline for the first time: RADAR-X (trendsetter/alt-press harvester, world-culture-news + city-culture beats) -- operator-requested experiment, 'have the chief editor put one of the existing personas to actually write the article' rather than commission a new persona. Required adding an `author` field to `collectionMetaSchema` (collections previously had none) and wiring the existing Byline component into CollectionHero. En.mdx rewritten first-person in RADAR-X's voice ('I read the alt-weeklies for a living...'); facts/sourcing/NearLink targets unchanged.
